summary.zh: 花有限的建筑资源，让敌人多走几步、多挨几轮攻击。
summary.en: Spend limited building resources to make enemies walk farther under fire.

rules.zh: 玩家在允许建造的地面放置障碍或防御塔，改变地面敌人前往目标的路线。既要留下可通行的道路，又要让敌人尽量多次经过火力覆盖区；路径预览和实际行军轨迹告诉玩家布局是否有效。
rules.en: Place obstacles or towers on buildable ground to change the route ground enemies take to their objective. Leave a legal route while increasing time spent under fire. A path preview and actual enemy movement reveal whether the layout works.

loop.en: Place obstacles to extend the route
Revise the layout where enemies escaped

decisions.zh: 用钱增加路程，还是直接买火力？路再长，伤害不足也守不住。
decisions.en: Spend on a longer route or another weapon? Extra walking time does little without damage.

decisions.zh: 把所有敌人汇到一个窄口很省塔，但也更依赖这一个位置。
decisions.en: A single choke saves towers but concentrates the defense into one vulnerable location.

effect.zh: 成本低时鼓励反复改路；成本高时每个拐弯都要证明价值。
effect.en: Cheap obstacles encourage route experiments; expensive ones must justify every detour.

effect.zh: 宽通路减少极端绕路，更强调火力覆盖；窄通路更强调迷宫布局。
effect.en: Wide passages reduce extreme detours and emphasize coverage; narrow ones reward maze planning.

contrast.zh: 前者主要通过塔阵延长敌人的受击时间；后者还要留出玩家移动和射击的位置。
contrast.en: Defense Grid mainly stretches exposure to towers; Sanctum also needs room for the player to move and shoot.

combination.zh: 组合提案：把迷宫墙接入模块拼装，同一堵墙可以旋转成两种走向，让玩家用少量部件修补漏洞。
combination.en: Design proposal: connect maze walls to modular construction, letting each piece rotate between two routes to repair gaps with few components.

setup.zh: 一个入口和出口之间只有直路，敌人很快跑出去。
setup.en: A straight path connects the entrance to the exit, so enemies cross quickly.

action.zh: 用三块墙围出一个U形弯，在弯心放一座箭塔。
action.en: Use three walls to form a U-turn and place an arrow tower inside it.

result.zh: 同一批敌人在射程内停留更久，但三块墙花掉了买第二座塔的钱。
result.en: The same enemies stay in range longer, but the walls consume money for a second tower.

next.zh: 观察是路程不够还是伤害不够，再决定下一笔钱投哪里。
next.en: Check whether travel time or damage is insufficient before the next investment.

firstStep.zh: 用二维方格、一个入口、一个出口、两种建筑做出可预览的寻路。
firstStep.en: Use a 2D grid with one entrance, one exit and two building types; show the calculated route.

pitfall.zh: 先不做多层地图和飞行敌人；必须先处理彻底堵路时的反馈。
pitfall.en: Defer multilevel maps and flying enemies; first make blocked routes give clear feedback.

test.zh: 测试者能否说清一块墙为何值得放在这里，并根据漏怪主动改路？
test.en: Can a tester explain why a wall belongs here and reroute after a leak?
